title: Evaluate WIT Component Model as alternative to JSON ABI for Felt extensions
description: Currently Felt extensions use a JSON-string ABI: host serializes game state to JSON, passes as bytes in linear memory, Felt runtime parses into GC structs. Alternative: define game state as a WIT interface (baize:game/state world) with concrete types. The canonical ABI handles marshaling — no JSON parsing at all. Smaller binaries, faster, type-safe at the interface boundary. Blocked on: (1) wasmtime Component Model + GC interaction maturity, (2) WIT recursive type support (needed for nested game state). Track and evaluate when wasmtime stabilizes Component Model + GC together.
close_reason: Moot — Felt extensions already use handle-based host imports (i32 handles, 37 builtins) instead of JSON ABI. Current approach is effectively a hand-rolled WIT. Re-evaluate if wasmtime ships Component Model + GC together, but no actionable work now.
